title: A living main menu and loading screen
summary: The Dungeon Train logo now comes alive in the game. The main menu shows whoever is streaming live, or a slideshow of the community's tributed photos, behind a slowly turning logo. When a world finishes loading, the train drives through a portal and becomes the logo.
highlights: Main menu: the live stream when someone is live, otherwise tributed photos credited to their photographer
Loading screen: the carriages fill in as it loads, then ride through a portal and turn into the logo
